chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-'Iys ibn al-Qasim, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'By God! Fifty years may pass over a man and God has not accepted a single prayer from him. So what thing is more difficult than this? By God! You know among your neighbors and your companions those who, if they were to pray for one of you, you would not accept it from them due to their belittling of it. Indeed God, Mighty and Majestic, does not accept except what is good. So how would He accept what is treated with contempt?'

key_terms.اسْتِخْفَاف: belittling, treating lightly, showing contempt (for the prayer)
key_terms.الْحَسَن: what is good, excellent, pure — the standard God accepts
key_terms.يَقْبَل: to accept (God's acceptance of acts of worship)

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq say about prayers not being accepted due to belittling salat?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) delivers a stern warning that a person may spend fifty years in prayer yet have none of it accepted by God due to belittling and disrespecting the salat. He appeals to his audience's own social standards: just as you would refuse a prayer offered on your behalf by someone you know to be contemptuous of it, God likewise only accepts sincere and properly observed worship. The hadith addresses communities in which outward performance of prayer had become routine but its spiritual and reverential dimensions had been neglected.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Al Ays Bin Al Qasim who said,

‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘By Allahazwj! There could come upon the man, fifty years (of age) and not a Salāt is Accepted from him. So which thing is more difficult than this? By Allahazwj! You know the ones in your neighbourhood and your companions, the one who, were to pray Salāt from one of you, it would not be Accepted from him due to his belittling with it. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic does not Accept but only pure, so how would Heazwj Accept what is belittled with?’
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Safwan ibn Yahya from al-‘is ibn al-Qasim who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘A man may become fifty years old, but Allah has accepted not even one Salah (prayer) from him. What can be more serious than this? By Allah, you may also find someone in your neighborhood who performs Salah (prayer) with you, but is not accepted from him due to his considering it insignificant. Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, does not accept anything other than what is good. How then He will accept what he considers insignificant?”’
